description.value:
When a creature within 5 feet of you deals you damage, you can use your reaction to hit it back with force damage equal to your consular level plus your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum +1). If the attacker is Huge or smaller, it must also succeed on a Strength saving throw against your universal force save DC or be shoved in a straight line up to 20 feet away from you.

You can use this feature five times, gaining an additional use at 17th level, with all uses restored after a short or long rest.
